item.title: Paulette Gebara Was Found In Her Bed After Nine Days
item.description: Four-year-old Paulette Gebara Farah was reported missing in Mexico in March 2010. Nine days later, investigators found her body between her mattress and bed frame. Authorities concluded she died accidentally and acknowledged failures in the initial search.

item.title: Patrick Clancy Forgave Lindsay Without Being Asked
item.description: Patrick Clancy told 60 Minutes he forgave his former wife, Lindsay, and believes mental illness caused their three children’s deaths. Lindsay has pleaded not guilty to murder; her trial ended in a mistrial in September 2026 after jurors deadlocked over criminal responsibility.
